name: Obsession
overview: Scripture reveals that obsession arises from an insatiable desire that defiles the heart and separates us from God. Proverbs 27:20 illustrates the restless nature of human longing, while Matthew 6:24 warns that divided allegiance between God and worldly wealth is impossible. True fulfillment is found not in pursuing every desire as in Ecclesiastes 2:10, but by seeking first the kingdom of God and His righteousness (Matthew 6:33). God’s commands, given in Exodus 20:1, call us to a wholehearted devotion that guards against the defilement caused by obsessive pursuits (Mark 7:20).
